items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: if Arthur Rubenstein hadn't retired, you'd have to get a ticket three or four years in advance to hear him play the piano.

ctx.x: Ted was at Symphony Hall, the Boston Symphony always sells out, the Pops sells out, the New York Philharmonic, Horowitz still sells out a concert hall. You can't get a seat -- if Arthur Rubenstein hadn't retired, you'd have to get a ticket three or four years in advance to hear him play the piano.
